subject: GitHub Actions Error: "Can't find package called INLA"

messages.author: b5a7def4edb1c16b
messages.subject: GitHub Actions Error: "Can't find package called INLA"
parts:
Hi All,

I'm using GitHub Actions to automatically check my R package. Previously, I didn't have any problem with INLA by first adding the INLA repo to the R options.

But, starting from sometime in May, it seems that it can't find the INLA package.

Has anyone else had this problem?
Is it something to do with the R 4.2 update?
 
my .github/ workflow yaml is:

- name: Add inla repo
run: |
writeLines('options(repos = c(INLA = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/", getOption(\"repos\")))', file("~/.Rprofile", "ab"))
shell: Rscript {0}

Thanks for any help!

Nathan

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] GitHub Actions Error: "Can't find package called INLA"
parts:
Hi,
This is likely due to what mechanism your actions use to install dependencies; I recently had to change how I do this for the inlabru package, so take a look at the action scripts at https://github.com/inlabru-org/inlabru/tree/devel/.github/workflows for how I solved the problem.

Finn
